描述_EN: round the border is the wave pattern found round the hems of chinese court robes. converging on the centre from all sides are eight dragons. golden-yellow satin heavily embroidered with gold thread and coloured silks mainly inlaid and couched work and split stitch. rectangular embroidered silk satin panel. the centre of the panel is occupied by a five-clawed dragon encircling a sacred pearl.
描述_ZN: 边框周围是中国宫廷长袍下摆的波浪图案。 从四面八方汇集到中心的是八条龙。 金黄色绸缎上大量绣有金线和彩色丝绸，主要是镶嵌和耦合的工作和分割的针法。 矩形绣花丝缎面板。 面板的中心是一条五爪龙，环绕着一颗神圣的珍珠。
